name: agent-bar
title: Agent bar
description: The voice-first bar for an agent that works in the background: a pill with a history arrow, the field, a mic (tap to listen, hold to talk and release to send) and send, an optional quoted-row chip, and AgentStatus, the one-line spinner or check above it. Dictation and the hold gesture are the kit's; the app supplies `transcribe` and `onSend`.
